name: Headband
summary: Headband is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] crossing [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[sour-diesel|Sour Diesel]], a pairing fixed by the seed release from [[breeder:DNA Genetics]]. Older references tie the name to East Coast Diesel lines of the 1990s. It is distinct from 707 Headband.

sources.title: Headband
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms OG Kush x Sour Diesel and 9–10 weeks of flowering.
